require 'digest'
workflows = {'.github/workflows/endpoint-ctest-protocol-gate.yml' => ['codex/endpoint-ctest-protocol-green-20260906', 10], '.github/workflows/endpoint-finalizer-negative-gate.yml' => ['codex/endpoint-finalizer-negative-gate-20260906', 15]}
results = []
workflows.each do |path, expected|
  w = YAML.load_file(path)
  events = w['on'] || w[true]
  raise 'unexpected events' unless events.keys == ['push'] && events['push']['branches'] == [expected[0]]
  raise 'unexpected jobs' unless w['jobs'].length == 2
  parsed = 0
  w['jobs'].each do |id, job|
    raise 'timeout changed' unless job['timeout-minutes'] == expected[1]
    job.fetch('steps').each do |step|
      raise 'hidden failure' if step.key?('continue-on-error')
      next unless step['run'] && ['bash', 'msys2 {0}'].include?(step['shell'])
      IO.popen(['/bin/bash', '-n'], 'w') { |io| io.write(step['run']) }
      raise 'Bash syntax failed' unless $?.success?
      parsed += 1
    end
  end
  results << {path: path, sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest, yaml_parse: 'PASS', bash_run_steps_parsed: parsed, jobs: 2, exact_trigger: expected[0]}
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate(results)
